purpose: Validates and normalizes target executable paths; enforces the allowlist of supported file extensions (.exe, .scr, .bat, .cmd, .lnk, .msi, .ps1, .vbs, .jar, .py).
called_by: ConfigManager.cs — NormalizePath and IsSupportedTarget during config load
TrayAppContext.cs — IsSupportedTarget and GetUnsupportedTargetMessage in UI
calls_out_to: Path.GetFullPath — resolves relative paths against AppContext.BaseDirectory
invariants: NormalizePath always returns a non-null string (empty string if input is blank or invalid)
IsSupportedTarget returns false for null/empty/unsupported-extension paths
gotchas: Paths are resolved relative to AppContext.BaseDirectory (the exe location) if not rooted — this matters for relative .bat paths
Environment variables in the path are expanded before extension checking
